data.name: Titusian
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Titos, which means 'honor', 'title', or 'dignity'. In the New Testament, Titus was an early Christian missionary who traveled with Paul and later became the Bishop of Crete. The name Titus is a symbol of Christian leadership and dignity.

in_hebrew.name: טיטוסיאן
in_hebrew.meaning: המשמעות של טיטוסיאן היא הגנה של אלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: טיטוסיאן הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו 'הגנה של אלוהים' או 'עבדו של אלוהים'. השם טיטוס הוא שורש השם טיטוסיאן, והוא נמצא בברית החדשה כשליח ותלמיד של פאולוס. השם טיטוסיאן משדר כוח רוחני והגנה אלוהית.

in_greek.name: Τιτουσιανός
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Τιτουσιανός είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό και σημαίνει 'προστασία του Θεού' ή 'υπηρέτης του Θεού'. Το όνομα Τίτος είναι η ρίζα του Τιτουσιανός και βρίσκεται στη Καινή Διαθήκη ως απόστολος και μαθητής του Παύλου. Το όνομα Τιτουσιανός εκπέμπει πνευματική δύναμη και θεϊκή προστασία.

in_latin.name: Titusianus
in_latin.long_meaning: Titusianus est nomen christianum quod originem habet in latino et significat 'protectionem Dei' aut 'servus Dei'. Nomen Titus est radix nominis Titusianus, et invenitur in Novo Testamento ut apostolus et discipulus Pauli. Nomen Titusianus spirat virtutem spiritualem et protectionem divinam.

in_english.name: Titusian
in_english.meaning: Titusian means protected by God or servant of God
in_english.long_meaning: Titusian is a Christian name derived from Latin, meaning 'protected by God' or 'servant of God'. The name Titus, from which Titusian originates, is found in the New Testament as a disciple and companion of Apostle Paul. The name conveys spiritual strength, divine protection, and a sense of servitude to God. Historically, it reflects the early Christian tradition of naming individuals with significant biblical connections.

biblical_reference.note: The name Titusian is not directly mentioned in the Bible but is associated with the biblical figure Titus.

data.cultural_impact: The name Titusian carries a rich cultural impact within the Christian community. It represents a history of devotion, leadership, and missionary work. Titus was one of the earliest missionaries in the early Christian church and his name has been passed down through generations as a reminder of the importance of spreading the teachings of Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_significance: Titusian is a name deeply rooted in spiritual significance for Christians. It symbolizes the dignity and honor that comes with being a follower of Christ. The name reminds us of the importance of living a Christ-like life, spreading His teachings, and upholding the dignity and respect that comes with being a child of God. It is a name that inspires us to lead with honor and humility, following the example of Titus and Paul.

He is believed to have written several letters, collectively known as the Clementine Recension of the Apostolic Fathers, which contain references to a man named Titus.

Titus Livius Patavinus, or Livy, was a renowned Roman historian who wrote The History of Rome from its founding to the death of Augustus (27 BC). In one of his accounts, Titus Manlius Torquatus is mentioned, a Roman military hero from the early Republic who was given the cognomen Titus after defeating the enemy Titans.
